Question: The Amaco Middle School bookstore sells pencils costing a whole number of cents. Some seventh graders each bought a pencil, paying a total of \(1.43\) dollars. Some of the \(30\) sixth graders each bought a pencil, and they paid a total of \(1.95\) dollars. How many more sixth graders than seventh graders bought a pencil?
